nl_20.name: Numbers on a Number Line (any scale)
nl_20.teaches: the number line as a counting and place-value tool: count along, find, place and estimate numbers on 0-20, 0-50, 0-100, 0-1,000, 0-10,000 and 0-1,000,000 lines, counting in 1s, 10s, 100s ... and with only some ticks labelled
nl_20.representation: a drawn number line with some ticks labelled; write the number at the arrow, or mark a number; option: scale; option: estimate on a line with only the ends marked

regroup_thousands.name: A Thousand Is Ten Hundreds (option)
regroup_thousands.teaches: 1,000 as 10 hundreds and 100 tens: exchange a thousand cube for ten hundred flats and back, and count in 1,000s
regroup_thousands.representation: one boxed cell: a black-outline thousand cube beside ten flats with an exchange arrow; the pupil writes "1 thousand = __ hundreds"; numbers in Andika, no colour
regroup_thousands.why: the exchange of thousands is the core of the Thousands step and no skill shows it

count_50s.name: Count in 50s, 100s and 1,000s (option)
count_50s.teaches: counting forwards and backwards in 50s, 100s and 1,000s, and seeing 10 hundreds as 1,000
count_50s.representation: step values 50, 100 and 1,000 on count_by_step_up / skip_count_line with a base-10 picture support

flex_partition.name: Partition Numbers Flexibly
flex_partition.teaches: partitioning a 2-, 3- or 4-digit number in more than one way (45 = 40 + 5 = 30 + 15), with base-10 and part-whole models
flex_partition.representation: a part-whole diagram with one part given; base-10 picture beside it; write the other part

more_less_all.name: 1, 10, 100 or 1,000 More or Less (option)
more_less_all.teaches: finding 1, 10, 100 and 1,000 more or less than a 4-digit number, including across a boundary (3,995 + 10)
more_less_all.representation: a "−n | number | +n" table cell with one empty box per row; optional place-value chart beside it with the changing column outlined
more_less_all.why: the skill offers 10, 100 and 1,000 but not 1, and never mixes all four on 4-digit numbers

roman_100.name: Roman Numerals
roman_100.teaches: reading and writing Roman numerals to 100 (I, V, X, L, C) and knowing there is no zero
roman_100.representation: numeral cards with a symbol key; write the value or the numeral

roman_12.name: Roman Numerals to 12
roman_12.teaches: reading Roman numerals I to XII on a clock face
roman_12.representation: a clock face with Roman numerals; write the time or the numeral value

add_sub_place_units.option: task "1s, 10s, 100s or 1,000s to a 4-digit number" and band 9,999
add_sub_place_units.name: Add and Subtract 1s, 10s, 100s and 1,000s (option)
add_sub_place_units.teaches: adding and subtracting a multiple of one place value to a 4-digit number (3,452 + 300, 6,105 − 4,000) with and without crossing a boundary
add_sub_place_units.representation: equation cell (3,452 + 300 = □) with an optional place-value chart above it, the changing column outlined in black; one answer box
add_sub_place_units.why: add_sub_100s deals only 100s to about 1,000; the WRM step opens the 4-digit block

add_sub_patterns.name: Spot the Pattern (+/−)
add_sub_patterns.teaches: using known facts to add and subtract 1s, 10s and 100s (3 + 4, 30 + 40, 300 + 400) and seeing what changes and what stays the same
add_sub_patterns.representation: a three-row fact ladder with the first row done; complete the others

exchange_count_add.option: exchanges: exactly one / two or more
exchange_count_add.name: How Many Exchanges? Addition (option)
exchange_count_add.teaches: column addition held to exactly one exchange, or to two or more exchanges, so the WRM one-exchange and more-than-one-exchange steps are separate pages
exchange_count_add.representation: the existing stack cell with regroup boxes (structural, every level); only the dealing changes
exchange_count_add.why: WRM splits one exchange from several (P-1: one new thing per step); the skill mixes them

exchange_count_sub.option: exchanges: exactly one / two or more
exchange_count_sub.name: How Many Exchanges? Subtraction (option)
exchange_count_sub.teaches: column subtraction held to exactly one exchange, or to two or more exchanges (not only across zeros)
exchange_count_sub.representation: the existing stack cell with exchange boxes; only the dealing changes
exchange_count_sub.why: WRM splits one exchange from several; the skill mixes them

mental_add_sub.name: Mental Addition and Subtraction
mental_add_sub.teaches: mental strategies for large numbers: partitioning, counting on, compensating, near multiples
mental_add_sub.representation: a strategy prompt (round and adjust) beside each calculation

vis_strategy_pictures.name: Strategy Pictures: Doubles and Constant Difference
vis_strategy_pictures.build: `support: 'pictures'` on doubles and halves (before → after picture pairs, dice / fingers pairs, double or not a double) and `model: 'shift'` on compensation (two short lines with matching hops; the constant difference)

inverse_check.name: Inverse Operations (option)
inverse_check.teaches: using the inverse to check and to find missing numbers in addition and subtraction with 5- and 6-digit numbers
inverse_check.representation: band option to 1,000,000 and an "addition checked by subtracting" variant

area_compare.name: Make and Compare Areas
area_compare.teaches: making shapes with a given area from squares and comparing areas by counting squares
area_compare.representation: two shapes on squared paper; circle the larger area or draw a shape of 6 squares

area_half_squares.name: Count Squares and Half Squares (option)
area_half_squares.teaches: finding the area of shapes on a square grid where some squares are cut in half on the diagonal (two halves make one square)
area_half_squares.representation: black-line square grid in the boxed cell; the shape outlined with the heavy line, half squares cut on the diagonal; answer slot "__ squares"; the single grey optional for the shape fill
area_half_squares.why: WRM Count squares includes half squares; the skill deals whole squares only

tables_links.name: Related Times-Tables
tables_links.teaches: using one table to find another: 2 → 4 → 8 by doubling, 3 → 6 → 12, 5 and 10, and 9 as 10 − 1
tables_links.representation: a three-column table with the known table given; fill the doubled table

div_by_itself.name: Divide by 1 and by Itself (option)
div_by_itself.teaches: n ÷ 1 = n and n ÷ n = 1 (and 0 ÷ n = 0), each with a sharing picture, then as facts only
div_by_itself.representation: equation cell 7 ÷ 7 = □ with an optional row of dots ringed into one group / seven groups (hint scaffold that fades); one answer box
div_by_itself.why: the 1 constant gives n ÷ 1 only; dividing by itself is not dealt

mult_three.name: Multiply Three Numbers
mult_three.teaches: multiplying three 1-digit numbers using the associative property (2 × 5 × 7 = 10 × 7)
mult_three.representation: three-factor expressions with a bracket prompt to choose the easy pair first

informal_mult.name: Partition to Multiply
informal_mult.teaches: informal written multiplication by partitioning (23 × 4 = 20 × 4 + 3 × 4), before the column method
informal_mult.representation: a part-whole or grid model with the partial products to fill

vis_array_options.name: Array Options (split, hidden, place-value counters, three factors)
vis_array_options.build: arrays gain a split line, a hidden part, finish-the-array, `counter: 'one' | 'ten' | 'hundred'`, `model: 'array-groups'` (an array of arrays for three factors) and expression matching; mult-grid takes non-consecutive heads

correspondence.name: Correspondence Problems
correspondence.teaches: one-to-many correspondence (each of 3 hats with each of 4 scarves; 1 bag holds 5) as multiplication
correspondence.representation: a table or tree diagram to complete, then the multiplication

how_many_ways.name: How Many Ways?
how_many_ways.teaches: counting combinations systematically (3 tops × 4 bottoms) as a multiplication
how_many_ways.representation: a picture grid of items; list or draw every pair; write the multiplication

km_m.name: Kilometres and Metres (option)
km_m.teaches: measuring and converting km and m, including mixed units (2 km 300 m)

metres.name: Measure in Metres (option)
metres.teaches: measuring and comparing lengths in metres, choosing cm or m
metres.representation: a metre stick picture; unit choice cm/m

missing_lengths.name: Missing Lengths in Rectilinear Shapes
missing_lengths.teaches: finding missing side lengths in rectilinear shapes and then their perimeter
missing_lengths.representation: an L or T shape with some sides labelled; write the missing lengths

regular_polygon.name: Perimeter of Regular Polygons (option)
regular_polygon.teaches: perimeter of regular polygons from one side (5 sides of 7 cm) and of any polygon
regular_polygon.representation: a polygon-type option on the perimeter skill

polygons.name: Regular and Irregular Polygons
polygons.teaches: naming polygons by the number of sides, and telling regular from irregular
polygons.representation: polygon line drawings; write the name and tick regular / irregular

frac_count.name: Count in Fractions
frac_count.teaches: counting up and down in unit fractions on a number line and past a whole (1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 1, 1 1/4)
frac_count.representation: a number line with fraction ticks; fill the missing counts

frac_beyond_1.name: Fractions Beyond 1
frac_beyond_1.teaches: counting beyond 1 in fractions, partitioning a mixed number into wholes and a fraction, mixed numbers on a number line
frac_beyond_1.representation: bar and number-line models with wholes shaded; write the mixed number

frac_whole_partition.name: Partition the Whole
frac_whole_partition.teaches: finding the fraction that completes a whole (1 − 3/5), as a part-whole or bar model
frac_whole_partition.representation: a bar model with one part given as a fraction; write the missing part

frac_compare_gt1.name: Compare and Order Fractions Greater Than 1 (option)
frac_compare_gt1.teaches: comparing and ordering improper fractions and mixed numbers
frac_compare_gt1.representation: a band option on compare / order_fractions

frac_nl_equiv.name: Equivalent Fractions on a Number Line (option)
frac_nl_equiv.teaches: equivalent fractions shown on stacked number lines

frac_add_multi.name: Add and Subtract More Fractions (option)
frac_add_multi.teaches: adding two or more fractions with the same denominator, adding fractions to mixed numbers, and subtracting from whole amounts (3 − 3/4)
frac_add_multi.representation: addend-count and "from a whole" options with a bar-model support

sub_break_whole.name: Subtract from a Mixed Number: Break the Whole (option)
sub_break_whole.teaches: subtracting a fraction larger than the fractional part of a mixed number by exchanging one whole (3 1/5 − 4/5)
sub_break_whole.representation: an "exchange a whole" band with a bar-model support
